description: A dark, moody oil-style painting of a dressing table at night. A large billboard on a pole towers above it, showing a woman's face with dramatic eye makeup and glossy lips against a pale background. The table holds makeup brushes in a cup, aerosol cans, lipsticks, compacts and loose brushes, with a warm lamp glowing on the left. An open laptop on the right shows a photo-editing interface. Nothing is gory and no text is legible.
